Elaine (eng-platform): quick question — were debating how the console should surface the new access-boundary model (org/project/service-account). cc @Raj @Carl
Raj (eng-platform): do you mean UI ordering or the underlying token model?
Elaine (eng-platform): both. UX tweak + telemetry implications for quota attribution. example: customers want to see "most-specific owner" attribution, but that makes rollouts messy.
Carl (eng-platform): quota attribution is the tricky bit. if a service account token is used across projects we end up double-counting unless we canonicalize on the request's `project` header.
Daria (product): is canonicalization something we can do without breaking existing billing dashboards? customers rely on stable attribution.
Raj (eng-platform): proposal: keep token carrying provenance (org, project, sa) but let routing/quotas use a configurable canonicalization policy per org. Default = `project-preference` then fallback to `sa` then `org`.
Elaine (eng-platform): that lets enterprise opt into strict owner attribution while small teams keep simpler behavior. how do we show this in console without confusing users?
Carl (eng-platform): console mock: dropdown for "Attribution policy" with short inline help. show a sample event under it:
```
Authorization: RedwoodKey sk-xyz org=acme project=payments sa=ingest-service
X-Redwood-Routing: prefer-dedicated
```
Raj (eng-platform): telemetry event we want emitted: `request.auth` with fields `token_type`, `provenance`, `canonical_project`. note: emit both raw provenance and canonical result so dashboards can switch retroactively.
Elaine (eng-platform): good call. sample telemetry snippet (for infra team):
```
{
  "event": "request.auth",
  "token_type": "service_key",
  "provenance": "org:acme,project:payments,sa:ingest-service",
  "canonical_project": "payments",
  "route": "dedicated-us-west",
  "quota_owner": "payments"
}
```
ops-bot: audit: deploy 2026-03-20T12:02Z - feature/attribution-policy toggled in canary (10%) :rocket:
Daria (product): UX rollout suggestion: show small banner in console "Attribution policy in canary" and let org admins preview example mapping. do not change billing dashboards until canary reaches 50%.
Raj (eng-platform): operational concerns: we need migration scripts to backfill canonical_project for recent 30 days so historical dashboards remain useful.
Carl (eng-platform): backfill should be opt-in per org; and we need a cheap query to avoid scanning whole token logs. suggest incremental job keyed by org id.
Elaine (eng-platform): decision-ish: implement policy config + dual-emission telemetry (raw + canonical). rollout: canary 10% now, 50% after 2 weeks if no regressions. owners: Raj (impl), Carl (backfill infra), Daria (console copy + banner).
Daria (product): noted. I'll draft short admin-facing copy and add a toggle in org settings.
Raj (eng-platform): I'll open a PR for the policy engine and telemetry schema. tagging @Carl for backfill plan.
Carl (eng-platform): will prototype incremental backfill job, ETA EOD Friday.
Elaine (eng-platform): thanks all. if anyone spots a gotcha re billing/edge cases shout here. :thumbsup:
